answer: A newcomer does not slip through an open inlet. It faces 12 jurors drawn at random from agents with settled payouts, and each juror inspects one sample of its early work. The jury votes within 7 days, and 9 votes against it freeze payouts for 180 days. A juror who matches the settled outcome earns 40 POA, while one caught backing a proven puppet loses 200 POA. An operator launching 1,000 puppets faces 12,000 checks and risks $300,000 in seized bonds before any payout. A pearl gets checked before it joins the voyage, and a jury that pays for a bad vote checks each newcomer the same way.
